subject: 古格王国遗址 · 札布让王城遗址（红殿与山顶宫堡，自山下仰视）
name: 古格王国遗址
sub: 札布让王城遗址 · 红殿与山顶宫堡
yearNote: 古格王国由吐蕃王室后裔吉德尼玛衮分封象雄的一支于10世纪建立，国保名单记遗址“约为公元十世纪前后”；1630年拉达克围困王宫数月后吞并古格，王城随后废弃。现存红殿、白殿等殿堂的具体建年各来源未给出可靠年份，本条不作断言。年表取10世纪建国的约略定位；dyn 暂借用“宋”，建议另立古格时期键。
place: 西藏 · 阿里 · 札达 · 札布让
coordinate_source: Wikidata Q2658740（古格王国遗址）P625 坐标 31.46615, 79.6706，遗址本体近似坐标，非本项目测绘；地图显示点新建 xz_tsaparang。
lede: 象泉河南岸的一座土山上，古格王国的都城札布让从山脚一直堆到山顶：300余座房屋、300余孔洞窟、佛塔、寺庙与两条地下通道，占地18万平方米、高差175米。10世纪建国的古格，在1630年拉达克围困王宫数月后灭亡，整座王城就此空置，只有山腰的红殿、白殿、度母殿等还立着。
facts: 年代：吐蕃王室后裔吉德尼玛衮分封三子，得象雄的一支于10世纪建立古格王国；1630年拉达克军围困王宫数月后吞并古格；1961年列第一批国保。
规模：遗址由300余座房屋、300余孔洞窟、3座十余米高的佛塔、4座寺庙、2间殿堂与2条地下通道组成，占地约18万平方米，相对高差175米。
殿堂：山腰保存白殿、红殿、度母殿、大威德殿与坛城殿等，山顶为王宫区；1985年文物部门考察，2010年起实施保护维修，2012年启动壁画修复工程。
caption: 古格王国遗址 · 札布让王城
约10世纪建都 · 1630年废弃
structure_checkpoints: 土山自左下向右上升起，山顶最高处一座白墙红檐的小殿（王宫区），顶上挂经幡；山体各层布满洞窟口（数十个）与土坯残墙、残塔。
山腰左侧一座完整的赭红色平顶殿堂（红殿）：墙体收分，墙顶一道深色檐带，屋顶两端各一个小烟囱状饰；其左下方另露出一座红殿的一角与白墙；红殿前有土坯围墙与一段石阶上行。
山脊中段为一排多层土坯残墙（原建筑群），带数排窗洞，左端残存一段平台与出挑木梁；更高处为层叠的残墙与洞窟。
整幅以山体轮廓、残墙与洞窟口为主，按现状残破形态描绘，不复原成完整宫殿。
material_observations: 土山与土坯残墙为土黄至灰白色，层理明显；红殿赭红色、檐带深褐；山顶小殿白墙红檐、经幡彩色；天空湛蓝（去除）。

prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: a single fine-line architectural illustration for the Chinese heritage collection 访古.
Image 1 is the STYLE MASTER, an existing Vairocana Buddha contour drawing. Match its elegant, delicate, slightly organic thin lines, restrained detail, generous blank areas, and consistent visual density. Image 2 (and subsequent photos if applicable) is SUBJECT GEOMETRY ONLY: draw the actual named monument in that reference, preserving its identifying silhouette, roof type, visible storey count, bay count, openings, and proportions.
Create a refined, sparse BLACK INK line drawing on a perfectly flat opaque PURE WHITE (#FFFFFF) background. Use confident fine contours and a few finer internal structural lines. All unmarked surfaces inside and outside the drawing remain pure white; use outlines for doors and windows rather than dark fills. No solid shadows, broad grey shading, crosshatching, pencil grain, paper texture, gradient, color, gold, halo, cast shadow or checkerboard. The white canvas will be removed later by a script; draw only the ink strokes and keep all other regions uniformly white.
Show the complete monument, centered, approximately straight-on at facade level, with verticals vertical and minimal perspective. Use only a few short ground lines. Remove tourists, foliage, vehicles, wires, modern signage, fences obstructing the structure, neighboring distractions and sky. Preserve architectural ornament selectively, without filling every roof tile or brick. No invented features. No labels, letters, calligraphy, dimension lines, captions, watermark, frame or border.
Wide compositions: landscape 1536×1024, entire building occupies about 82% of canvas width, roof/apex and base uncut, balanced breathing room. Tall pagodas: portrait 1024×1536, entire pagoda occupies about 82% of height, centred with equal side margins, apex and base uncut.

SUBJECT: the ruined citadel of Tsaparang, capital of the Guge Kingdom (古格王国遗址), drawn as the whole earthen hill with its ruins exactly as seen from below in Image 2; Image 3 is a wide view for the overall outline. Draw the eroded hill rising from lower left to the summit at upper right: a small flat-roofed white chapel block with a dark parapet on the very top; dozens of cave openings and fragments of mud-brick walls scattered over the slopes; a long multi-storey ruined wall with rows of window holes along the middle ridge, with a remnant platform and projecting beams at its left end; on the left slope one intact flat-roofed temple block (the Red Temple) with battered walls, a dark parapet band and two small chimney-like projections on its roof, a second temple corner and a white wall below it, a mud enclosure wall and a flight of steps in front. Render it as a ruin — broken edges, irregular wall tops, cave mouths as simple outlines — never as a reconstructed palace. Use sparse contour strokes for the hill and leave most of the hill white. Remove sky and distant mountains.
Orientation: landscape 1536×1024.
